title: Composition equation for explicit Picard tensor counits
statement: Fix derived categories on all schemes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $W$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq W$ an open, $E\in D(\mathcal O_W)$, and $K$ any complex of modules on the open site. Set $P=\operatorname{overEquiv}(U)(K)$, and let $e:L(U.\iota)^*E\to QP$ be any morphism. Use the pinned comparisons $c$ [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] and counits $\eta$ [def-sc-picard-termwise-models]. For $s:T\to U$ and $h:s;U.\iota=t$, define the morphism $b_{t,s,h}=(c(s,U.\iota);h)^{-1}_E;Ls^*(e);\eta_s(P)$. For every $i:T\prime\to T$, $i;t=t\prime$, $i;s=s\prime$, and both factorizations through $U$, one has $b_{t\prime,s\prime,h\prime};Q(w)= (c(i,t);(i;t=t\prime))^{-1}_E;Li^*(b_{t,s,h});\eta_i(P_s)$, where $P_s$ and $w:P_{s\prime}\cong i^*P_s$ are the explicitly defined termwise model and comparison [def-sc-picard-termwise-models]. No perfectness or invertibility hypothesis is imposed on $K$ or $e$. Derived pullbacks are those of [def-pc-derived-pullback].

source.place: Tags 06YJ and 0D5S; the counit equation for composition, expanded through the homotopy quotient

proof.text: Substitute t′=i;t, s′=i;s, and t=s;U.ι using ht, hs, and hf. Proof irrelevance identifies the remaining factorization proof hf′ with Category.assoc. Take inverse components at E of the pinned derived-pullback associativity law for i,s,U.ι. Expand b and the functor maps. This replaces the two successive inverse comparisons on the right by the associativity transport, the comparison for i;s,U.ι, and c(i,s).inv at L(U.ι)E.

Naturality of c(i,s).inv at e moves it after L(i;s)(e). Apply the counit equation on the complex P=overEquiv(U)(K) from lem-sc-picard-termwise-composite-counit-core to replace c(i,s).inv_(QP);Li*(η_s(P));η_i(P_s) by η_(i;s)(P);Q(w). Reassociate; the sides coincide. No counit or e is canceled.

proof_origin.description: Reduction by a proved private coherence helper: equality induction, the existing triple-composition law, and naturality leave only the two-morphism counit factorization on a complex.

lean.statement:
theorem picard_termwise_composite_counit
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (E : schemeDerivedCategory W) (U : W.Opens)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (e : (derivedPullback U.ι).obj E ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)) :
    let c : ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z),
        derivedPullback g ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅ derivedPullback (f ≫ g) :=
      fun f g ↦ Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))) f g
    let P := ((Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K
    let b : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W) (s : T ⟶ U.toScheme),
        s ≫ U.ι = t → ((derivedPullback t).obj E ⟶
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj (picardTermwiseModel W U K s)) :=
      fun {T} t s hf ↦
        ((c s U.ι ≪≫ eqToIso
          (congrArg (fun g : T ⟶ W ↦ derivedPullback g) hf)).inv.app E) ≫
        (derivedPullback s).map e ≫ (picardTermwiseCounit s).app P
    ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
      (s : T ⟶ U.toScheme) (s' : T' ⟶ U.toScheme)
      (ht : i ≫ t = t') (hs : i ≫ s = s')
      (hf : s ≫ U.ι = t) (hf' : s' ≫ U.ι = t'),
      b t' s' hf' ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (picardTermwiseModelRestrictionIso W U K i s s' hs).hom =
        ((c i t ≪≫ eqToIso
          (congrArg (fun g : T' ⟶ W ↦ derivedPullback g) ht)).inv.app E) ≫
          (derivedPullback i).map (b t s hf) ≫
            (picardTermwiseCounit i).app (picardTermwiseModel W U K s)
